23 July 2026

Press conference

Introductory statement

Good afternoon. The euro area economy is growing at a moderate pace.

Inflation is projected to average 2.2% in 2027.

Core inflation remains elevated but is expected to decline gradually.

Inflation expectations remain well anchored.

Inflation is currently being driven mainly by energy prices.

The unemployment rate stood at 6.4% in June 2026 and wage growth is expected to moderate.

Risks to the economic outlook are broadly balanced.

The Governing Council is determined to ensure that inflation returns to the 2% target.

The Governing Council stands ready to adjust all of its instruments within its mandate.

Questions and answers

Question: Will the Governing Council raise interest rates further this year?

President Christine Lagarde: We will decide meeting by meeting on the basis of the incoming data.

We do not pre-commit to a particular rate path.

Question: What are your expectations for growth?

Vice-President Luis de Guindos: GDP is projected to grow by 1.6% in 2028.

Risks to growth are balanced.

European Central Bank, 2026
